item.title: Different Stages of a SaaS Development Team
item.description: The team I am on is responsible for SaaS development. We have a few flagship SaaS products and also some supporting ones. The flagship SaaS products have complex architectures, large technical challenges, and heavy staffing, and they are the focus of our KPIs. But a flagship project cannot stay the flagship forever — projects have life cycles and phases.

item.title: Thinking on the Cooperative Way Between PaaSer and SaaSer
item.description: 1. Work Scenario The team I am on has 20+ people and carries the responsibilities of both PaaS and SaaS development. The people who develop PaaS, the PaaSer, are mainly responsible for developing and maintaining the PaaS platform, with the goal of providing the SaaS developers with the APIs and documentation they need.
